div.font: Figure. PTM variant classification pipeline. UniProt PTM sites are mapped to GRCh38 genomic coordinates via Ensembl GTF, then cross-referenced with variant data (ClinVar or gnomAD). Three analysis tracks address: (Q1) landscape enrichment of pathogenic variants at PTM sites, (Q2) predictor evaluation via workflow composition with PSROC, and (Q3) population-level allele frequency comparison. Results are combined into an HTML report with embedded plots.
